text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for fn-call / structured output. Want to surface a compat toggle and ensure SDK behavior is explicit. starting with 5% canary in prod tomorrow AM.
Maria: Sounds good. Which flag key are we using?
Alex: Using `ff.fncall.structured_output` (boolean) + `ff.fncall.sdk_behavior` (enum: `legacy`, `strict`, `auto`).
Kevin: Quick Q — does `auto` behave like legacy for older SDKs? we should avoid breaking desktop clients.
Sophie: `auto` will keep legacy traffic on older SDKs; new SDKs opt-in to `strict`. we'll gate by client-version header.
Taylor: Can we add a server-side compatibility fallback so that if a client sends `function_call` expectations but fails, we fall back to text-only? prefer defensive behavior.
Alex: Yes — fallback policy: if structured output runtime error OR response schema mismatch -> fallback to `text_completion` (same prompt) and mark metric `fncall.fallback.v1`.
Maria: Guardrails request: limit canary to accounts not in enterprise prod (to avoid SLA noise). Suggested audiences: internal, beta-customers, 5% sampled external.
Kevin: People to ping for code review? I can take the SDK docs and rollout snippet. Alex, Sophie for runtime changes.
Alex: Assigned: Kevin -> SDK docs + client-version gating PR, Sophie -> runtime guardrail + fallback, Taylor -> flag config + infra rollout script, Maria -> canary list + monitoring dashboard.
Sophie: Implementation note: need to atomically flip `ff.fncall.structured_output.enabled` and `ff.fncall.sdk_behavior` for the canary buckets, otherwise mixed configs lead to inconsistent runtime paths. will add an integrity check in the toggler.
Taylor: Draft flag patch (example):
```json
{
  "key": "ff.fncall.structured_output",
  "type": "boolean",
  "default": false,
  "overrides": [
    {"audience": "internal", "value": true},
    {"audience": "beta_customers", "value": true},
    {"audience": "sample_external_5pct", "value": true}
  ]
}
```
Taylor: Also adding `ff.fncall.sdk_behavior` with `auto` as default for now.
Maria: Monitoring: please emit these metrics from runtime on rollout start: `fncall.requests`, `fncall.success`, `fncall.fallback`, `fncall.schema_errors`, `fncall.latency_p50/p95`. Set alert if fallback ratio > 0.5% or schema_errors spike > 0.2%.
Alex: Agreed. Dashboards: Maria will create a per-audience dashboard + a canary feed in Redwood Console.
Kevin: SDK change: default still `legacy` until we ship new SDK version. will add opt-in flag `structuredOutput: true` in SDK init. docs PR incoming.
Sophie: Runtime PR is up: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/4210 — adds compatibility layer + a toggle integrity check. requesting review from @Alex and @Taylor.
Alex: Reviewing now. quick note: make sure logs tag request with `flag_state` in traces for easy aggregation.
Taylor: infra rollout script in https://git.redwood/infra/ops/commit/6a7d2b — will run canary at 09:00 UTC tomorrow with automated rollback on alert. deploy-bot: scheduling will be posted.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: ff.fncall.structured_output -> sample_external_5pct at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. Auto-rollback on `fncall.fallback` > 0.5% for 5m or `schema_errors` > 0.2% for 5m.
qa-bot: Reminder: QA smoke tests for structured payloads are in `tests/e2e/fncall_smoke.py`. Please ensure CI passes before enabling external canary.
Maria: CI is green for canary branch. I've added the beta customers list (csv) to vault.
Kevin: PRs: SDK docs #1553, client-version gating #1554. tagging @Sophie for runtime compatibility.
Sophie: Merged runtime PR to `canary` branch. leaving note: watch memory increase on long-kv-cache scenarios — added metric `fncall.kv_cache_size`.
Alex: Quick checklist before go: 1) Docs + SDK opt-in ready (Kevin) — in progress. 2) Runtime guardrail tested (Sophie) — done on canary cluster. 3) Flag config applied to internal/beta (Taylor) — done. 4) Dashboards + alerts (Maria) — done. 5) QA smoke passing (qa-bot) — CI green.
Taylor: After 24h healthy canary, we can ramp from 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 6hr holds. Also plan a rollback window for enterprise customers if anything shows up.
Maria: Noting opt-out process for customers who want to remain legacy: add a per-account toggle (console) -> product will handle support.
Alex: Thanks all. If no objections, start the 09:00 UTC canary. I'll post final go in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Kevin: lgtm :rocket:
Sophie: :+1:
Taylor: :thumbsup:
